ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.quote: Tainted Blade cuts healing on every physical hit and makes blighted targets take more damage from his abilities, a direct answer to Grux. Augmentation empowers a basic attack after each cast. Aegis of Agawar adds percentage physical and magical armor, doubled below 40% health, and Giant's Ring adds physical armor plus cooldown refunds when he is basic-attacked. Aegis's percentage bonus is the only magical defense, so no item adds flat magical armor into Zinx and Argus.
